items.why: The owner creates the private key and keeps it outside every checkout. The tracked-file and ignore-pattern tests of item 2 show that nothing committed holds a key or a signing password.
The owner uninstalls the debug-signed or old-ID build from the Shield before the first private-key install; the evidence records it.
A documentation item (docs/security.md, the PR body); no test reads a document's wording.

items.note: The second command runs the new scripts/tv-app-identity.test.ts, which the root suite holds. The Product Owner's frozen-file commit changes the done tasks' tests that hold the old ID; AppIdentityTest (pnpm tv:native:test) and pnpm tv:apk:check on the built APK are regression evidence the verify step quotes.
